meta.summary: A browser extension to control your Pi-hole conveniently from within the browser.

blocking.title: Blocking control
blocking.description: Toggle Pi-hole blocking on or off from the popup, or temporarily disable it for a preset duration (10s, 30s, 5m, 30m, 1h) so it re-enables automatically.

domain.title: Domain management
domain.description: See whether the current tab's domain is blocked or allowlisted and toggle it instantly, without opening the Pi-hole admin interface.

stats.title: Stats
stats.description: View today's query count, blocked count, block percentage, and cache hits, each with a 24-hour sparkline. Optional donut charts break down queries by status and type.

systemInfo.title: System info
systemInfo.description: See uptime, CPU load, memory usage, and temperature at a glance in the popup.

groups.title: Groups and lists
groups.description: Enable or disable blocking groups and individual blocklists directly from the popup.

multiInstance.title: Multiple Pi-holes
multiInstance.description: Connect to multiple Pi-holes and switch between them with per-instance tabs in the popup.

badge.title: Toolbar badge
badge.description: Shows blocked percentage, ON/OFF state, or active client count.

customization.title: Customization
customization.description: Adjust the popup layout, badge behavior, language, and more from the extension options.
